title: A great way to see the Alhambra!
text: Taking this tour with Sandra was great.  She provided a lot of history and fun facts without overload.  She’s very knowledgeable and a lovely person.
author: Brooklyn-Jared

title: Great Guided Tour
text: We met with our guide Maria right in the parking lot. Maria was an exceptional, excellent guide. Articulate, engaging, and so knowledgeable. Our tour of Alhambra gardens, GeneraLife, forts, and palaces were perfect and stress free. I highly recommend this tour and Maria.
author: Marilyn_K

title: Great professional and fall in love with your city
text: The experience has been very rewarding. Guided tour in La Alhambra for four people that we will never forget. Sandra is a great professional and communication with her of 10.
author: 125andr_sj

title: Great visit with a wonderful guide
text:
We booked the tour without having tickets, so we had to scramble to find last minute tickets. Almost impossible, but we did learn that the Granada Card 72hour includes tickets. 

We then had to change our tour date and Sandra was pleasant and accommodating. It worked out great. 

The tour was good, she arrived well before our meeting time, she definitely had some deep knowledge of the Alhambra and was able to answer all of our questions. I would recommend her as a tour guide.
author: padvisor2020

title: Unique experience through the surroundings, palaces and history. Fundamental to be accompanied by a guide like Sandra.
text: A guided tour by Sandra, excellent in explanations, incredible knowledge of the history and a perfect pace of visit with details very less. Highly recommended.
author: Q7665EZmariap

title: Gorgeous tour with Sandra, an excellent guide
text: We have visited the Alhambra and the Generalife with Sandra who is an amazing guide. She knows everything about this wonderful place, everything you can ask, be it in English or Spanish. She told us many interesting stories and she showed us beautiful details and corners in the buildings and gardens. My little daughter was challenged to play Sherlock Holmes with a photo quiz and was excited to find the answers. It was a lovely visit for the whole family with a great guide!!!
author: Aventurera713

title: From the best guides in Granada
text: The visit was wonderful. The guide very attentive and super competent. We cleared all the doubts that always arose and also gave us very interesting data. A great guide full of knowledge and who also knew how to transmit them very well. We would repeat without hesitation
author: amparos552

title: One of the best experiences.
text: A fantastic experience. Sandra (the guide), was very friendly, attentive and very punctual. The information was very interesting and intuitive. I recommend this tour 100%. Definitely an experience not to forget!
author: enekoprado13

title: Unforgettable experience
text: Spectacular visit to the Alhambra and Generalife. Sandra (our guide) made the visit, with her sympathy, kindness and explanations, more magical. We would certainly repeat this experience again.
author: sifres2016

title: Unforgettable guided tour of the Alhambra
text: Ours was a private tour for two people throughout the Alhambra complex. I definitely recommend Sandra for anyone visiting the beautiful city of Granada. In our case we spent more than three hours visiting the monumental complex in detail and provided all the information and knew how to answer all our questions. In short very professional but also attentive and friendly.
author: Javier A
